Hi Sarah — happy to clarify. Key details: 

- Audit period (inclusive): 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.
- Report issuance date: 2026-02-18 (Redwood SOC 2 Type II Report).
- Point-in-time: The report includes both period-of-time testing (controls that are evaluated continuously throughout the coverage window) and point-in-time testing as applicable. Where the auditor performed point-in-time sampling, the report explicitly notes the assertion date (most commonly 2025-12-31).

A few helpful notes:
- "Period-of-time" controls (example: privileged access reviews, patch management cadence, backup job schedules with evidence) were evaluated for operation throughout the full period.
- "Point-in-time" controls (example: physical access observation, certain configuration snapshots) are tested at a specific date and that date is referenced in the auditor's testing matrix.

We have attached the final SOC 2 Type II PDF and the bridge letter issued at report time. If you need an auditor-signed bridge letter covering the interval between the report issue date and today, we can provide the standard bridge letter (see attachment) — it affirms no material changes in the control environment since report issuance.

If your team requires a quick summary mapping ("which controls are period-tested vs point-in-time") we can prepare a one-page mapping; it will reference auditor test identifiers and sampling dates.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Jan1-Dec31_2025.pdf; SOC2_bridge_letter_Feb2026.pdf
